entities.name: City of Shadows
entities.description: A hidden settlement and school of magic-users on western Terisiare, heir of the College of Lat-Nam and the Third Path.

entities.name: College of Lat-Nam
entities.description: A fallen magic school whose heirs founded the City of Shadows.

entities.name: Third Path
entities.description: Scattered group of mages whose survivors founded the city.

entities.name: Drafna
entities.description: Surviving Third Path member who helped found the City of Shadows.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Church from which the city hid.

entities.name: Sima
entities.description: A member of the school who met her future husband Jodah.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Mage who travelled to the City of Shadows after the Conclave's fall.

entities.name: Shannan
entities.description: Surviving Conclave mage who traveled to the city.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: Northern rival school that fell to Lord Ith.

entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: Responsible for the fall of the Conclave.

events.summary: After the fall of the College of Lat-Nam, Drafna and other Third Path survivors found the City of Shadows in hiding from the Church of Tal.
Sima meets her future husband Jodah during a search beyond the city.
events.quote: This is how Sima , a member of the school, met her future husband Jodah .

events.summary: After the Conclave falls to Lord Ith, surviving mages including Jodah and Shannan travel to the City of Shadows.
events.quote: making it the sole remaining school of magic on Terisiare

events.summary: Vervamon's party visits the apparently abandoned city and suffers terrifying prophetic dreams before leaving.
events.quote: The party abandoned the city the next day.

events.summary: The oncoming Ice Age forces the School of the Unseen to relocate beyond the ice.
events.quote: forcing the mages to move the School of the Unseen to a new location

relations.quote: seeing the need to hide from the Church of Tal
